title: 수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00009:part:1/1

Article 7 (Fisheries and Fishing Villages Climate Impact Assessment Advisory Committee)
(1) Where necessary to respond to requests for advice from the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries concerning climate impact assessments, etc. and fact-finding surveys, the Minister may establish and operate a Fisheries and Fishing Villages Climate Impact Assessment Advisory Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee").
(2) The Committee shall be composed of not more than 15 members, including one chairperson.
(3) The chairperson shall be the Director General for Fisheries Policy of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, and the members shall be:
1. The Director General for Fisheries Policy, Director General for Fisheries Resources Policy, and Director General for Fishing Village and Aquaculture Policy of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries;
2. Persons commissioned by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, taking gender into consideration, from among persons with abundant knowledge and experience in climate, ecology, fisheries, fishing villages, etc.
(4) The term of office of members under paragraph (3) 2 shall be three years: Provided, That where the Committee is dissolved pursuant to paragraph (8), their terms shall expire upon dissolution.
(5) The chairperson shall convene meetings of the Committee and preside over them.
(6) Where the chairperson is unable to perform duties due to unavoidable circumstances, a member designated in advance by the chairperson shall act on behalf of the chairperson.
(7) Meetings shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of incumbent members and resolutions shall be adopted by the affirmative vote of a majority of members present.
(8) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries deems that the purpose for which the Committee was established has been achieved, the Minister may dissolve the Committee.
(9) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Committee, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (8), shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.
